description: You are a Logistics Coordinator at Great Lakes Intermodal Transport. You need to create a formal Master Bill of Lading (BOL) package for a multi-stop LTL shipment departing today. The shipment details (shipper, consignees, line items, hazmat info) are in the file /home/ga/Documents/shipment_data.json. Using Apache OpenOffice Writer, create a professional documentation package including: (1) A title with the BOL number, (2) Auto-generated Table of Contents, (3) Sections for Shipper/Carrier Info, Cargo Manifest, Delivery Schedule, Hazmat Declaration, and Certifications using 'Heading 1' and 'Heading 2' styles, (4) Tables for the cargo manifest, delivery schedule, and hazmat items, (5) Page numbers in the footer. Save the final document as /home/ga/Documents/GLI_BOL_2024_03847.odt. Login: username ga, no password required.
